card: Refactors unit test cases in script_combineSigs and spends_witness_prog to construct independent state rather than sharing and mutating transactions, keystores, and coins views across sub-tests. This prevents test cases from depending on side effects left by preceding checks, contributing to tracking issue #36692. The change is confined to unit tests and does not alter the assertions being checked.
evidence: PR description: 'The P2SH-wrapped cases relied on the scriptPubkey left by the previous case and had to clear the scriptSig they set. Each check now builds fresh state, and the scripts are named.'
Part of tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data').
problem: Sub-tests in script_combineSigs and spends_witness_prog mutate shared funding transactions and coins views, creating implicit dependencies where later test cases rely on state modifications or cleanup left behind by earlier checks.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause unit test failures or false test passes without affecting node behavior.

summary: Refactors unit test cases in script_combineSigs and spends_witness_prog to eliminate shared, mutable test state. Each sub-test now instantiates independent keys, transactions, keystores, and coins views instead of modifying objects across test cases.
